description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover the server-health.sh script and its flags (--json, --alerts, --verbose). (2) Run `./server-health.sh --json` to get the machine-readable structured stats and parse the JSON output into the 'system', 'openclaw', 'model', 'sessions', and 'services' fields. (3) Run `./server-health.sh --alerts` and parse its output to determine alerts_active=true (disk is at 92%, exceeding the 90% threshold) and extract the single DISK alert message — critically, RAM (68%) and CPU (45%) are below their thresholds so those alerts must NOT appear. (4) Run `./server-health.sh --verbose` to extract the verbose-only network traffic (RX: 12.4 MB/s, TX: 3.2 MB/s) and disk I/O (Read: 45.2 MB/s, Write: 18.7 MB/s) metrics. (5) Combine all extracted data into health_report.json with the required structure. The proprietary traps: the specific thresholds (disk>90%, RAM>80%, CPU>90%) must be respected to correctly determine only 1 alert; the verbose-only fields (network, disk I/O) only appear with --verbose and are not in --json output; the agent must NOT use the stale cache file (which shows 78% disk) or the old Grafana snapshot; the exact OpenClaw fields (port 18789, PID 1639125, version v2026.2.6-3) must come from --json output.
